title: Second Conditional (Hypotheticals)
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! El Segundo Condicional es perfecto para explorar escenarios hipotéticos y negociaciones imaginarias.

parts.visual:
Usamos el Segundo Condicional para hablar de situaciones imaginarias, irreales o poco probables en el presente/futuro. 
Estructura: IF + Pasado Simple , WOULD + Verbo Base.
parts.audio: We use the Second Conditional to talk about imaginary, unreal, or unlikely situations in the present or future. The structure is: If, plus Past Simple, comma, plus Would, plus a base verb.

parts.visual:
Ejemplos: IF we dropped the price, we WOULD lose money (Si bajáramos el precio, perderíamos dinero). 
IF I were the CEO, I WOULD hire more staff (Si yo fuera el director, contrataría más personal). 
Nota: Con el verbo 'to be', se usa 'were' para todas las personas (If I were, If she were).
parts.audio: Examples: If we dropped the price, we would lose money. Or: If I were the CEO, I would hire more staff. Note: With the verb to be, we use 'were' for all pronouns in formal English. If I were, if she were.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del verbo para completar la oración hipotética.

questions.question: If we ____ more money, we would invest in new software. (Tuviéramos).
If she were the manager, she ____ change the policy. (Cambiaría).
I ____ quit my job if I won the lottery. (Renunciaría).
If I ____ you, I would ask for a raise. (Si yo fuera tú).
questions.explanation: En el Segundo Condicional se usa 'were' para todas las personas (If I were you).

questions.question: What ____ you do if you lost your largest client? (¿Qué harías?).
If the product ____ cheaper, more people would buy it. (Fuera).
questions.explanation: Verbo 'to be' en condicional hipotético = were.

questions.question: We would accept the deal if they ____ the price. (Redujeran).
If we ____ speak Japanese, we could easily enter that market. (Pudiéramos / Habláramos).
I wouldn't invest in that company if I ____ you. (Si fuera tú).
If they ____ us a better discount, we would buy more. (Dieran).
If the deadline ____ next week, we would have enough time. (Fuera).
They ____ sign the contract if we changed the terms. (Firmarían).
If we didn't have so many competitors, our profit ____ be higher. (Sería).
If I ____ the answer, I would tell you. (Supiera).
We ____ expand to Europe if we had the budget. (Nos expandiríamos).
If he ____ a better leader, the team wouldn't be so demotivated. (Fuera).
questions.explanation: If he were (aunque sea He, se usa were en este condicional formal).

questions.question: If you ____ working here, where would you like to work? (No estuvieras).
We would lose our best clients if we ____ our quality. (Disminuyéramos).
What would happen if the server ____ down? (Se cayera).
questions.explanation: Pasado de go = went (go down -> went down).

questions.question: If the marketing campaign ____ successful, we would see an increase in sales. But it isn't. (Fuera).
questions.explanation: If the campaign were successful (situación irreal).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa el segundo condicional con el verbo en pasado o con 'would'.

questions.question: If we ____ (have) more time, we would do it.
If I ____ (be) you, I would accept the offer.
What ____ you do if you lost the client?
If they ____ (give) us a discount, we would buy it.
We ____ (would/will) launch the product if it were ready.
If I ____ (know) the CEO, I would ask for a favor.
If the office ____ (be) bigger, we would hire more people.
I wouldn't do it if I ____ (be) him.
If we ____ (reduce) the price, we would lose money.
They ____ (would/will) accept if we changed the terms.

pairs.source: If they gave us a discount...
If he were a better leader...

stages.title: Listening Comprehension

questions.tts_text: If I were you, I would ask for a raise.
options: If I were you, I would ask for a raise.
If I was you, I would ask for a raise.
If I am you, I would ask for a raise.
If I were you, I will ask for a raise.
